                  PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                    TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                     3920-3932 S Calumet Avenue



Ml-3 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to a RMS Residential Multi-Unit District.

The purpose of the rezoning is to comply with the use table and standards of the RMS and meet
the bulk and density requirements to sub divide one zoning lot and develop into 7 individual
zoning lots to construct 7 3-story 3 dwelling unit masonry residential buildings with three-car
parking garages. The height of the buildings will be 32 feet. No commercial will be provided.
